punchline: Bell's detector was aimed only where the doctors expected the bullet.
thirty_sec: In July 1881 Alexander Graham Bell brought an induction balance to the wounded Garfield. Bliss held the coils and led the search to one area; Bell privately knew the machine registered no real difference. The bullet was not where the doctors had said.
question: Which test at work is aimed only at the place where everyone expects the answer?
key_contrast: A belief said with certainty is not a measurement.
